_version_comment: bump when the measured setup changes (rebot_sim.scene_version())
_comment: Real hackathon setup of the reBot B601 (measured, see reference_photos/).
All lengths in metres. Positions use WORKSPACE coordinates:
from_left = distance from the left wall (the black board, bin side)
from_near = distance from the near wall (the cardboard wall behind the robot)
height    = height above the table top
Seen from behind the robot: the robot looks towards the far (open) edge, the bin is on its left.
Values marked in _assumed are guesses from the photos: measure and correct them here.
_assumed: bin.from_left (from the table homography, see bin._comment)

robot._comment: joint-1 axis. The black base plate is part of the robot mesh (20 x 14 x 1.4 cm), standing on the table at z = 0.

bin._comment: White foam box, 25 cm (left-right) x 40 cm (near-far). from_left: the real arm's table homography (classic_real branch) puts its robot-side bottom edge 30 cm from the joint-1 axis, i.e. 5 cm closer to the robot than flush against the left wall (sketch). Measure the gap to the left wall to confirm.
bin._dividers_comment: fractions along near->far where an inner wall splits the box into compartments

_cameras_comment: fov_diagonal_deg + aspect are converted to MuJoCo's vertical fovy (or give fovy directly)

cameras.name: cam_far
cameras._comment: LeRobot camera (100 deg) on the far edge, ~30 cm high. Pose and fovy fitted to the real frame (pinhole fit of a lens with barrel distortion)

cameras.name: cam_corner
cameras._comment: Logitech C920 (~75 deg diagonal) on a gooseneck from the far-right corner; the head sits over the right wall. Pose fitted to the real frame, fovy pinned to the C920 spec
cameras._calibrated: tools/calibrate_cameras.py: reference_photos/cameras + the real arm's table homography (classic_real)

wrist_camera._comment: camera on the reBot gripper (the teleop model's `wrist`), recorded at full 1920x1080. pos/look_at in the end_link frame: +x along the fingers (hard-finger tips at x=0, the soft fingertips at x=0.0286), +y finger travel, +z away from the finger plane.

spawn_region._comment: where RealSetupEnv.randomize_objects() may put objects (workspace coords)

charuco._comment: Printed ChArUco board lying flat on the table, edges parallel to the walls, caption edge towards the robot. near_left = workspace position of the pattern's corner nearest the left and near walls. Set enabled=true when it lies there (capture sessions then calibrate the cameras from it). Make it: python -m rebot_sim.charuco board.pdf

tape._comment: Yellow tape on the table (reference_photos new_reference_*.jpg). The long line runs from the near wall to the far edge, flush against the right edge of the robot's base plate (as in the photos; the annotated photo says 27.5 cm from the right wall, 1.4 cm more than the plate allows with the robot 38 cm from that wall). The three marks: wall-side end 12 / 12.5 / 13 cm from the right wall, centres 25 / 43.5 / 60.5 cm from the near wall (annotated photo, rough). Strips are [from, to] ranges in workspace coords.
